rule: per measured platform (and `any`: all of them), relative to the reference platform's value alone. `tolerances`, the round-off class: max(10 x the largest relative spread of the quantity, 1e-10), for a spread up to 1e-07. `over_ceiling`, the class of a quantity that spreads more because the problem solved differs: [10 x its spread, the spread, the platform], for a spread below 0.5 / (10 + 0.5), so that the platform's own value, halved or doubled, is outside the tolerance. `unasserted`: a quantity that spreads more than that, with its spread and platform. Mesh-sized quantities are not asserted. A leaf that is not a number, and the layout, are compared exactly, except those listed as unasserted_discrete (with the reference's value and each platform's) and unasserted_layout because they were measured to differ
